facts.statement: Free Realms' Yeti character was featured in a second television commercial, announced in a Spanish-language news post on freerealms.com.

facts.statement: Free Realms released its second television commercial, which features the Yeti, and invited viewers to watch and share it.

article_summaries.title: El Yeti de Free Realms en la TV
article_summaries.summary: This is a short Spanish-language SOE news post on the freerealms.com site announcing the second television commercial featuring the Free Realms Yeti, and inviting players to watch and share it. The page is a site news item with no gameplay, quest, item or mechanic details. The post is dated only relatively ('Posted 1 year, 5 months ago' at the 2011-06-04 capture), so its exact date is unknown, likely around early 2010.
